mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past month indicates a contraction in consumer and housing demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth < 0%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy response that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 0% and FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level below 156,000 thousand signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS < 156000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 1% and a decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST declines >1% and GDPC1 declines >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines.
